title: Two-Body Problem
description: Determining the motion of two mutually interacting bodies. In Newtonian mechanics, an isolated pair with equal-and-opposite internal forces separates into center-of-mass motion and relative motion governed by the reduced mass; an additional central-force assumption permits the usual orbital reduction.

relations.note: The separated equations follow by summing and subtracting the two particle equations with equal-and-opposite internal forces.
